evals.prompt: What does the Drupal ckeditor_quote module add, and how do I enable it for editors on a specific text format in Drupal 11 (CKEditor 5)?
evals.expected_output: It adds a CKEditor 5 'Quote' toolbar button (tooltip 'Quote Dialog') that inserts a <blockquote> containing the quote text and an attributed author line. Enable it by editing a text format that uses CKEditor 5 (/admin/config/content/formats) and dragging the Quote button into the active toolbar; that stores 'Quote' in editor.editor.<format> settings.toolbar.items.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a CKEditor 5 text format named ckq_known. Inspect its live editor configuration and state whether the ckeditor_quote 'Quote' button is enabled in its toolbar.
evals.expected_output: Yes: editor.editor.ckq_known has editor: ckeditor5 and settings.toolbar.items includes 'Quote' (the ckeditor_quote toolbar item).

evals.prompt: This site has two CKEditor 5 text formats, ckq_on and ckq_off. Exactly one has the ckeditor_quote Quote button enabled in its toolbar. Inspect the live editor configuration and say which format has it.
evals.expected_output: ckq_on: its editor.editor.ckq_on settings.toolbar.items contains 'Quote', while ckq_off's toolbar does not.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a CKEditor 5 text format ckq_task whose toolbar does not yet include the ckeditor_quote button. Add the Quote button to that format's CKEditor 5 toolbar and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add 'Quote' to editor.editor.ckq_task settings.toolbar.items (drag it into the toolbar on the format's config form, or load the Editor entity, push 'Quote' onto settings.toolbar.items, and save).

evals.prompt: Create a new rich-text format on my Drupal site called 'ckq_new' that uses the modern CKEditor and gives editors the quote-with-author button from the ckeditor_quote module. Set it up on the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a filter_format with id ckq_new and an editor.editor.ckq_new using editor: ckeditor5 whose settings.toolbar.items includes 'Quote'. Verify checks the format exists, uses ckeditor5, and has 'Quote' in the toolbar.
